hero.intro.en: Find the gap, forge what it takes, mend it.
hero.intro.zh: 发现缺口，炼五色石，动手补上

page.home.title.zh: 郑凯欣 · 学习设计师

work.intro.en: Tools, structures and processes built for specific classroom problems, all of them in use.
work.intro.zh: 为具体的课堂问题而做的工具、机制和流程，目前都在使用中。

approach.leadA.en: Design thinking is a five step cycle. In a classroom, only the test settles anything.
approach.leadA.zh: 设计思维是一个五步循环。但在课堂里，真正说了算的只有「测试」。

approach.loop1P1.en: Students could not hold on to vocabulary, and a passage left them defeated.
approach.loop1P1.zh: 学生记不得词语，看到篇章就感到挫败。

approach.loop1P2.en: The whole cohort, not one class.
approach.loop1P2.zh: 整个级别都这样，不只一个班。

approach.loop1P3.en: Vocabulary is learnt by repetition, and repetition is what they resist most.
approach.loop1P3.zh: 词汇要靠重复来学，而重复正是他们最抗拒的。

approach.loop2P1.en: The problem is vocabulary, not comprehension.

approach.loop2P2.en: Not how to make it fun. How to make them choose to practise.
approach.loop2P2.zh: 不是怎么让词汇变有趣，是怎么让学生自己选择去练。

approach.loop2P3.en: It has to cover G1, G2, G3, Higher Chinese and the beginner pier.
approach.loop2P3.zh: 要覆盖 G1、G2、G3、高级华文与出发码头。

approach.loop3P1.en: Motivation goes into the structure: autonomy, competence, relatedness.
approach.loop3P1.zh: 动机放进结构里：自主、胜任、关联。

approach.loop3P2.en: Game elements do not motivate by themselves. Each is picked for the need it serves.
approach.loop3P2.zh: 游戏元素本身不产生动机，每一个都照它要服务的需求来挑。

approach.loop3P3.en: Ask again after a delay, and run one word list through several modes.
approach.loop3P3.zh: 隔一阵子再考，同一份词表跑几种模式。

approach.loop4P1.en: A build that runs, not a mockup.
approach.loop4P1.zh: 真能跑的版本，不是示意图。

approach.loop5P1.zh: 三个班，47 名学生给了反馈。

approach.loop5P2.en: Colleagues nodding is not evidence. Students using it alone is.
approach.loop5P2.zh: 同事点头不算证据，学生自己用才算。

approach.loop5P3.en: Which words keep failing, which screen nobody opens: those are the design documents.
approach.loop5P3.zh: 哪些词一错再错、哪个页面没人去，这些才是设计文档。

approach.loopClose.en: Then round again from the top. Every version of VocabSummit came out this way, and each lap starts from a better question than the last.
approach.loopClose.zh: 然后从头再跑一遍。「词山学海」每一个版本都是这样跑出来的，而每一圈的起点，都是一个比上一圈更好的问题。

colophon.source.en: The Chinese name of this site, from the Book of Changes, Great Commentary
colophon.source.zh: 本站中文名，语出《易经 · 系辞》

page.nlc26.title.en: 2026 AI in Sec CL NLC - Chun Kai Xin
page.nlc26.title.zh: 2026 AI in Sec CL NLC · 郑凯欣

nlc26.title.en: Splitting heaven and earth with an AI axe — how VocabSummit got built
nlc26.title.zh: 挥舞AI之斧开天辟地 —— 词山学海的创作现场

nlc26.epigraphSrc.en: Lu Xun, My Old Home · this community’s motto
nlc26.epigraphSrc.zh: 鲁迅《故乡》· 本学习社群的题词

nlc26.handsTitle.en: Hands-on: turn what you already have into an interactive game
nlc26.handsTitle.zh: 动手环节：把手上的资源变成互动游戏

nlc26.handsLede.en: Excel → Claude → GitHub Pages. No coding background needed.
nlc26.handsLede.zh: Excel → Claude → GitHub Pages。（零编码基础可操作！）

nlc26.stuck1.en: Blank page, or a message saying something looks wrong with the sheet: it names the line. Almost always a missing comma, quote, or brace.
nlc26.stuck1.zh: 页面空白，或跳出「词语表好像有点问题」：提示会写第几行。九成是少了逗号、引号或大括号。

nlc26.stuck2.en: Can't find Claude's file: look in Downloads, then drag it back into the game folder.
nlc26.stuck2.zh: 找不到 Claude 给的文件：看「下载 / Downloads」资料夹，再拖回游戏资料夹。

nlc26.stuck3.en: GitHub Pages shows 404: it needs a minute or two after Save. Then hard refresh, Cmd+Shift+R or Ctrl+F5.
nlc26.stuck3.zh: GitHub Pages 是 404：按了 Save 之后要等一两分钟。然后强制刷新（Cmd+Shift+R / Ctrl+F5）。

nlc26.stackLede.en: A one-person department. So how does it run six roles?
nlc26.stackLede.zh: 一个人的部门，怎么会有六个岗位？

nlc26.p1Cycle.en: decides what to build, and what counts as built well
nlc26.p1Cycle.zh: 决定做什么、什么算做好

nlc26.p1A.en: What to build, who it is for, and what counts as getting it right.
nlc26.p1A.zh: 做什么、给谁用、怎样才算做对了。

nlc26.p2Cycle.en: works out what is being built, and writes it down
nlc26.p2Cycle.zh: 理清来龙去脉，写下规格

nlc26.p2A.en: Decisions, notes and word lists in one Project, so you never explain twice.
nlc26.p2A.zh: 设计决定、教学笔记、词表都放同一个 Project，不必每次重讲。

nlc26.p3A.en: It reads the files itself, edits, runs them, then checks its own work.
nlc26.p3A.zh: 它自己读文件、动手改、跑起来，再看对不对。

nlc26.p4Cycle.en: draws it, and makes the artwork

nlc26.p4A.en: The cliff, the landscape, the climber: all generated.
nlc26.p4A.zh: 游戏里的山壁、风景、角色，全是生成的。

nlc26.q1.en: Where does student data go, and is it compliant?
nlc26.q1.zh: 学生数据放在哪里？合规吗？

nlc26.q1A.en: It depends what you build. Today's game collects nothing: no sign-in, no server, and nothing left behind when a student closes the page. A version like that has no data question at all.
nlc26.q1A.zh: 看你做什么。今天这个游戏什么都不收：没有登录、没有服务器，学生关掉网页就什么都不留。这种版本没有数据问题。

nlc26.q1B.en: The moment you add accounts and saved progress, the data sits on somebody else's servers. Which region it sits in, who can read it, and how long it is kept all have to follow school and MOE rules.
nlc26.q1B.zh: 一旦加上账号和进度储存，数据就落在第三方的服务器上。存在哪个地区、谁读得到、保存多久，都要照学校和教育部的规定走。

nlc26.q1C.en: The order that works: build the version that collects nothing, put it to use, and take up compliance only when you genuinely need to track progress. The other way round tends to stall for months.
nlc26.q1C.zh: 行得通的顺序是：先做不收数据的版本，先用起来，等到真的需要追踪进度了，再去谈合规。反过来做，往往一拖好几个月。

nlc26.q2.en: With no IT support, who maintains this later?
nlc26.q2.zh: 没有 IT 支援，以后谁来维护？

nlc26.q2A.en: A static page, which is HTML plus pictures, needs almost no maintenance. On GitHub Pages it will still open years from now, untouched.
nlc26.q2A.zh: 一个静态网页（就是 HTML 加图片）几乎不用维护。放在 GitHub Pages 上，几年不动它也照样能开。

nlc26.q2B.en: The kind that needs maintaining is the other kind: accounts, a database, sign-in. That is the practical reason not to add them unless you must.
nlc26.q2B.zh: 需要维护的是另一类：有账号、有数据库、要登录的。这正是「能不加就不加」的现实理由。

nlc26.q2C.en: With the code on GitHub rather than on your laptop, a colleague can pick it up after you transfer. Far safer than a folder on your own desktop.
nlc26.q2C.zh: 代码放在 GitHub 上而不是你的手提电脑里，你调职了同事也接得下去。这比存在自己桌面上的文件夹安全得多。

nlc26.q3.en: Will this work on a school-issued laptop?
nlc26.q3.zh: 学校发的电脑做得到吗？

nlc26.q3A.en: Today's hands-on will. It needs a browser and a plain text editor, and every machine already has both.
nlc26.q3A.zh: 今天的动手环节可以。只需要一个浏览器和一个纯文本编辑器，这两样每台电脑本来就有。

nlc26.q3B.en: The step that needs an install, running Claude Code on the machine itself, may be blocked on a managed device. Use the web version instead, or your own device.
nlc26.q3B.zh: 要安装软件的那一步（在本机跑 Claude Code）在受管制的设备上可能装不了。可以改用网页版，或者用自己的设备。

nlc26.q3C.en: School networks sometimes block github.com. Known in advance it is just a different route; discovered on the spot it is a panic.
nlc26.q3C.zh: 学校网络有时候会挡 github.com。事先知道，就只是换个方法；当场才发现，就会慌。

nlc26.q4.en: I cannot code at all. Can I really do this?
nlc26.q4.zh: 我完全不会编码，真的做得到吗？

nlc26.q4A.en: Today's hands-on, yes. It was designed from the start for someone who cannot code.
nlc26.q4A.zh: 今天这个动手环节可以。它从一开始就是照着「不会编码的人」来设计的。

nlc26.q4B.en: Building something the size of VocabSummit does not need coding ability either. It needs the willingness to keep saying clearly what you want, and the judgment to tell whether what came back is right. Teachers do both every day.
nlc26.q4B.zh: 做一个像词山学海那样规模的东西，需要的也不是编码能力，而是「愿意反复把要什么讲清楚」加上「判断做出来的东西对不对」。这两件事教师每天都在做。

nlc26.q4C.en: No point prettifying it though: it takes time, you get stuck, and some evenings produce nothing. About the same workload as preparing a whole new unit from scratch.
nlc26.q4C.zh: 但也不必美化：会花时间，会卡住，会有几个晚上什么都做不出来。这跟从零备一套全新的单元，工作量差不多。

nlc26.dVenue.zh: 地点 · 中正中学（总校）

nlc26.dAudience.en: Audience · the 2026 AI in Sec CL NLC: 13 clusters, 16 schools, 18 Secondary Chinese Language teachers
nlc26.dAudience.zh: 对象 · 2026 AI in Sec CL NLC：13个学区、16所学校、18位中学华文教师

nlc26.dSpeaker.en: Speaker · Chun Kai Xin, Head of Mother Tongue, Bukit View Secondary School
nlc26.dSpeaker.zh: 主讲 · 郑凯欣，百德中学母语部主任

nlc26.stuck4.en: The school network blocks github.com or claude.ai: phone hotspot, or do it at home. You do not need Claude either: open my-words.js in Notepad or TextEdit and type your words straight in.
nlc26.stuck4.zh: 学校网络挡住 github.com 或 claude.ai：用手机热点，或回家再弄。不用 Claude 也行：用记事本或「文本编辑」打开 my-words.js，直接把词语打进去。

nlc26.storyTitle.en: Splitting heaven and earth out of chaos. When you can do none of it, where do you begin?
nlc26.storyTitle.zh: 在一片混沌中开天辟地。在什么都不会的时候，到底怎么开始？

nlc26.storyCap.en: The first message I sent Claude:

nlc26.storyP2.en: What I asked for was an SLS HTML5 interactive package. Building it, I found the idea would not fit inside SLS's existing structure. Step by step, it grew into what is now VocabSummit.
nlc26.storyP2.zh: 我要的本来是一个 SLS HTML5 互动课件，却边做边发现这个构想装不进 SLS 现有的架构里。于是它一步一步，长成了今天的“词山学海”。

nlc26.statStudents.zh: 名学生提供了真实反馈

nlc26.shot1.en: The landing page, and where the name comes from
nlc26.shot1.zh: 首页 · 「词山学海」这个名字的由来

nlc26.shot2.en: The climb: each unit is a stretch of mountain, and progress is altitude
nlc26.shot2.zh: 攀登 · 每个单元是一段山路，进度则是海拔

nlc26.storyClose.en: The move, over and over: say what you want, look at what it made, then say what needs adjusting.
nlc26.storyClose.zh: 反复的动作：说清楚要什么，看它做出什么，再说哪里要调整。

approach.loop2P4.en: It works if they practise without being told to.
approach.loop2P4.zh: 没人叫他也会去练，才算成功。

approach.loop3P4.en: The name is the design: a mountain you can see yourself climbing.
approach.loop3P4.zh: 名字就是设计：一座看得见自己在爬的山。

approach.loop4P4.en: In front of students the moment it was usable.
approach.loop4P4.zh: 勉强能用就送到学生面前。

approach.needsTitle.en: Motivation has to be designed, not hoped for
approach.needsTitle.zh: 动机要设计，不能光指望学生自觉

approach.needsLead.en: Self-Determination Theory turns one vague question into three you can actually answer. Each of the three starts from something students really say, and every feature below is an answer to one of them.
approach.needsLead.zh: 自我决定理论把一个含糊的问题，拆成三个答得上来的问题。三个问题都是从学生真会说出口的一句话来的，下面每一个功能，都在回答其中一个。

approach.need1Voice.en: “I am forced to learn Mother Tongue.”

approach.need1Q.en: How does a student feel they are the one deciding?
approach.need1Q.zh: 怎样让学生觉得这件事是自己做主？

approach.need1P1.en: Twelve zodiac climbers, free when you register. Everyone picks their own. Nothing is assigned.
approach.need1P1.zh: 十二生肖攀登者，注册就免费挑一个。人人自己选，不分配。

approach.need1P2.en: Five story climbers cost 300 to 600 in game currency, and that currency only comes from practising and winning. Four mythic beasts have no price: clear one annual trial, unlock one, Secondary 1 through 4.
approach.need1P2.zh: 五个故事角色，300 到 600 不等；那是游戏币，只能靠练习和赢回来。四头神兽不标价：中一到中四，每通过一次年度试炼就解锁一头。

approach.need1P3.en: Learn mode is pure self-study: your own pace, no timer, no score. Game mode takes the same words into challenges and races. Switch between them whenever you like.
approach.need1P3.zh: 学习模式就是纯自学：自己的节奏，不计时，不计分。游戏模式是同样的词，换成挑战和竞速来练。两边随时可以换。

approach.need1P4.en: Which words, and when: the student sets that every time they open it.
approach.need1P4.zh: 每次进来，练哪些词、什么时候练，都是学生自己定。

approach.need2Voice.en: “I keep doing badly in Mother Tongue.”

approach.need2Q.en: How do they see themselves managing it, often enough to believe it?
approach.need2Q.zh: 怎样让他们常常看见自己做得到，常到自己都信？

approach.need2P1.en: Experience points only go up. A wrong answer costs nothing you have earned.
approach.need2P1.zh: 经验值只加不减，答错也不倒扣，赚到的分一分不少。

approach.need2P2.en: One badge per chapter component: everyday life, core, consolidation, advanced, culture. Finish the component and it is yours, however well you scored.
approach.need2P2.zh: 每个单元板块一枚徽章：生活用语、核心、巩固、增益、文化。一个板块练完就有，不看你考得好不好。

approach.need2P3.en: Powerups cost game currency, and that only comes from practising: an extra life, a combo shield, five seconds off the clock, a first mistake that does not count, one wrong option removed. Each is named after an object with a story behind it.
approach.need2P3.zh: 道具要花游戏币，而游戏币只能练出来：多一条命、连击护盾、冻结计时五秒、第一次答错不算、去掉一个错误选项。每一件都取自一样有典故的物件。

approach.need2P4.en: 3,889 entries across G1, G2, G3, Higher Chinese and the beginner pier. Wherever a student starts, the motivation design is the same one.
approach.need2P4.zh: 3,889 个词条，涵盖 G1、G2、G3、高级华文与出发码头。起点在哪里都一样，用的是同一套动机设计。

approach.need3Voice.en: “Nobody close to me uses Mother Tongue outside class.”
approach.need3Voice.zh: 「我身边的人，下了课没人用母语。」

approach.need3Q.en: How does practising stop being something you do on your own?
approach.need3Q.zh: 怎样让练习不再是一个人的事？

approach.need3P1.en: Classroom climbs, started by the teacher or by the students themselves.
approach.need3P1.zh: 课堂共攀：老师可以发起，学生自己也可以发起。

approach.need3P2.en: Peer challenges: two friends go at the words they are both working on.
approach.need3P2.zh: 同伴对战：朋友之间，用两人都在练的词比一场。

approach.need3P3.en: A live leaderboard while the climb is running, and a badge for placing on it.
approach.need3P3.zh: 爬的时候有实时排行榜，上榜有名次徽章。

approach.needsClose.en: This is the argument I put to the school leadership in August 2026.
approach.needsClose.zh: 这就是 2026 年 8 月我跟校领导讲的那一套。

nlc26.goal1.en: Get to know Claude and GitHub.

nlc26.goal2.en: Create your own GitHub Page, and publish a learning game on it.
nlc26.goal2.zh: 创建自己的 GitHub Page，发布一款学习小游戏

nlc26.p5A.en: Every change leaves a record, and a bad one can be rolled back.
nlc26.p5A.zh: 每一次改动都留下记录，改坏了退得回去。

nlc26.p5B.en: GitHub Pages turns it into a link for nothing.
nlc26.p5B.zh: GitHub Pages 免费把它变成网址。

nlc26.handsFloor.en: Which of these will you take on today?
nlc26.handsFloor.zh: 今天你希望接下哪些挑战呢？

nlc26.s1P1.en: github.com → Sign up. A personal email is fine. Free, and no card.
nlc26.s1P1.zh: github.com → Sign up。用个人邮箱就行。免费，不必给信用卡。

nlc26.s1P2.en: github.com/new → name it VocabClimbStarter, the same as everyone else in the room → Public → Create repository.
nlc26.s1P2.zh: github.com/new → 仓库名用 VocabClimbStarter，全场统一 → 选 Public → Create repository。

nlc26.s1P3.en: Open my starter → green Code button → Download ZIP → unzip. About 540KB. On a slow network, take it off a thumb drive instead.
nlc26.s1P3.zh: 打开我的示范项目 → 绿色的 Code 按钮 → Download ZIP → 解压。约 540KB，网络慢就用随身碟拷。

nlc26.s1P4.en: Back in your empty repository → uploading an existing file → drag in everything you unzipped, art folder included → Commit changes.
nlc26.s1P4.zh: 回到你的空仓库 → 点 uploading an existing file → 把解压后的东西全部拖进去，art 资料夹也要 → Commit changes。

nlc26.s1P5.en: Settings → Pages → Deploy from a branch → main → / (root) → Save. Wait a minute or two.
nlc26.s1P5.zh: Settings → Pages → Deploy from a branch → 选 main → 选 /(root) → Save。等一两分钟。

nlc26.s1P6.en: https://yourusername.github.io/VocabClimbStarter/ is live. The words in it are still mine, but it is already a link a student can open. That is this stage finished.
nlc26.s1P6.zh: https://你的用户名.github.io/VocabClimbStarter/ 活了。里面还是我的示范词语，但它已经是一个学生打得开的网址。到这里就算完成。

nlc26.s2P1.en: The folder has an .xlsx template and a .csv. Two columns: the word, and its meaning. Row 1 stays as it is. Eight entries or more, and you never write wrong answers: distractors come from your other entries.
nlc26.s2P1.zh: 资料夹里有「词语表模板.xlsx」和一份 .csv。两栏：词语、释义。第一行不需修改。8 个以上，错误选项不用你写，程序会从你其他词语的释义里抓。

nlc26.s2P2.en: claude.ai → Projects → new one. Upload the whole folder and your filled-in sheet. The folder matters: it is how Claude sees the format it has to match.
nlc26.s2P2.zh: claude.ai → Projects → 新建一个。把整个资料夹和你填好的词语表都上传进去。资料夹一定要传：Claude 得看见原本的格式，才知道要照着什么写。

nlc26.s2P3.en: Put Claude's my-words.js back in the folder, replacing the old one. Double-click index.html and play a round. This checking step is the actual skill.
nlc26.s2P3.zh: 把 Claude 给你的 my-words.js 放回资料夹，覆盖原来那个。双击 index.html，先自己玩一局。这一步的检查，才是真正要学的本事。

nlc26.s2P4.en: Back in your repository, open my-words.js → the pencil icon → select all, delete, paste in what Claude gave you → Commit changes. Refresh the link and your students are playing your words.
nlc26.s2P4.zh: 回你的仓库，点开 my-words.js → 铅笔图标 → 全选删掉、整段贴上 → Commit changes。刷新网址，学生玩的就是你的词语了。

nlc26.s3P1.en: Six colours sit at the very top of index.html, each with a comment saying what it controls: dark panel, light text, accent, correct, wrong, button surface.
nlc26.s3P1.zh: index.html 最上面有六个颜色，每一个后面都有中文注解写明它管什么：深色底、浅色字、强调色、答对、答错、按钮底。

nlc26.s3P2.en: Three pictures in the art folder: landscape.jpg behind everything, wall.jpg for the cliff, climber.png for the climber. Swap the files, keep the names, and it just works.
nlc26.s3P2.zh: art 资料夹里三张图：landscape.jpg 是远景，wall.jpg 是崖壁，climber.png 是攀登者。换掉文件、名字不变，就换好了。

nlc26.s3P3.en: Ask for a school-colours version, or an ink-painting one. Then read it on your own phone: contrast is where this goes wrong, and whether your students can read it is a judgment only you can make.
nlc26.s3P3.zh: 让它做一版校色的，或者一版水墨的。做好后拿自己的手机看一看：这一步最容易出问题的是对比度，而学生看不看得清，只有你判断得了。

nlc26.s4P1.en: No starter folder at this stage, and nothing of mine to build on. It simulates next term, when I am not standing here.
nlc26.s4P1.zh: 这一阶段不给底稿，也不给我的东西让你改。模拟的是下个学期我不在旁边的时候。

nlc26.s4P2.en: Open a new Project, empty. Do not open with what you want built. Open with where your class is stuck, who the students are, and what material you already have.
nlc26.s4P2.zh: 开一个新的 Project，空的。别一上来就说你要做什么，先说你班上哪里卡住、学生是谁、你手上现成有什么材料。

nlc26.s4P3.en: Ask for three different approaches before it builds anything, then pick one. Choosing between three is a far better use of it than accepting the first thing it offers.
nlc26.s4P3.zh: 先让它给三个不一样的做法，别急着让它动手，再从三个里挑一个。让它给你三个选择、你来挑，比接受它端出来的第一样东西有用得多。

nlc26.s4P4.en: Publishing is the same steps as stage 1. And this is exactly how VocabSummit started: a problem, a link, and the sentence I do not know how to start. That message is further up this page, unedited.
nlc26.s4P4.zh: 做出来之后，发布还是第一阶段那几步。「词山学海」当初就是这么开始的：一个问题、一个网址、一句「我不知道怎么开始」。那则讯息就在这一页上面，一字没改。

nlc26.promptCapS4.en: A shape, not a script. Write over it.
nlc26.promptCapS4.zh: 这只是个架子，照你自己的情况改

nlc26.stuck5.en: Broke it: in your repository, History → the last version that worked → Revert. Two clicks and you are back. This is the whole reason the code lives on GitHub instead of on your desktop.
nlc26.stuck5.zh: 改坏了：进你的仓库，History → 上一个还能跑的版本 → Revert。两下就回来了。代码放 GitHub 而不是放桌面，为的就是这个。

nlc26.stuck6.en: The starter is MIT licensed: adapt it, use it in class, rebuild it for another subject. Keep the attribution. The artwork comes with it.
nlc26.stuck6.zh: 示范项目 MIT 许可：自由改编、用于课堂、改成别科都可以，保留署名即可。美术素材一并提供。
